The '''JN-66''' was a model of [[Analysis droid/Legends|analysis droid]] produced by [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] as a high-end [[Cleaning droid/Legends|utility droid]] as early as the [[Ruusan Reformations/Legends|Ruusan Reformations]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] made a large purchase of JN-66 units for use in the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple's]] [[Analysis Rooms/Legends|analysis wing]].

==History==
After production began on the line, the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] purchased a large number of JN-66's to operate the [[Analysis Rooms/Legends|analysis wing]] of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] in conjunction with several [[SP-4 analysis droid/Legends|SP-4]] droids. Between the two models, the JN-66's worked with most of the equipment while the SP-4's handled the menial tasks, such as direct Jedi-interface. All of the droids and their computers shared data with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Police]], making it easier to hand criminal cases over to different jurisdictions and to ensure a [[Coruscant Security Force database|comprehensive database]] was maintained.<ref name="TJP" /> All droids at the Temple were stripped of coverings for frequent irradiation baths so as to not contaminate the analysis chamber.<ref name="NEGD" /> These models not only served at the Temple, but also saw use in battlefield medical facilities during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] such as on [[New Holstice/Legends|New Holstice]].<ref name="Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown">''[[Star Wars: Republic: Trackdown]]''</ref>

==Characteristics==
[[File:Jn-66andSP-4.jpg|thumb|left|JN-66 (left) with [[SP-4 analysis droid/Legends|SP-4]].]]

The JN-66 analysis droid was a [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsorlift]]-equipped [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with four colored [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], with multi-wavelength imaging at extreme levels of magnification, set into its flat face. Cybot Galactica reused the chassis and many of the components found in the less-sophisticated [[PK-series worker droid/Legends|PK-series worker droid]], and the JN-66's framework also served as the basis for the company's [[IM-6 Battlefield Medical Droid/Legends|IM-6 battlefield medical droid]]. They were fitted with advanced verbobrains and sensor apparatus that made the droid an expensive commodity.<ref name="NEGD" />
